name: mock-first
description: Visual-first spec workflows for Claude Code: agree on the screen before you write the code. Ships the core PRD -> mockup -> tasks -> code loop across seven platform profiles, plus three Android variants that build on each other.

plugins.name: mock-first
plugins.description: Agree on the screen before you write the code. PRD -> mockup -> tasks -> code workflow with impact-aware revisions, targeted through per-platform profiles: web, mobile web, Android, iOS, or desktop on macOS, Windows or Linux. Start here for a single-module project.

plugins.name: android-factory
plugins.description: Mock-First scoped to an Android multi-module apps factory, so a shared-module change is reported against every app that depends on it. /android-factory:build-app takes a brief and a reference app to a ready-to-try app in one pass.

plugins.name: play-store
plugins.description: From upload key to Send for review for one app module: signing, AdMob, screenshots, per-locale listing, Play Console, release, in-app products, ASO. Pulls in android-factory.

plugins.name: portfolio
plugins.description: Publish a shipped app to an Astro portfolio site, generate its privacy policy and Data Safety summary, and report stale entries. Pulls in play-store.
